title: Serial refusals
subtitle: Every time head office told a till a scanned pack was already sold or held: who asked, where, and what it collided with.

note.sections: Click a row to see the refusals behind it. “Unknown staff” is a till on an older build that sent no staff id: many people, never one, so it is never a repeat offender.
note.refusals: Newest first. The receipt number is the basket the till was ringing up; an older till build sends none.

tileHint.refusals: Every refusal in scope: one per refused pack per answer.
tileHint.sold: The pack had already been sold.
tileHint.held: A picking document holds the pack.
tileHint.crossStore: Sold refusals where another store sold the pack.
tileHint.sameStore: Sold refusals where the asking store itself sold the pack.
tileHint.unknownSale: Sold refusals where the sales ledger named no sale.
tileHint.staff: Distinct staff ids that were refused.
tileHint.unknownStaff: Refusals from tills that sent no staff id.

columnHint.baskets: Distinct baskets (store, till and receipt) that asked. A till on an older build names none.
columnHint.lastBasket: Store · till · receipt of the newest refusal.
columnHint.crossStore: Sold refusals where another store sold the pack.
columnHint.trxNumber: The receipt number of the basket being rung up. Blank from an older till build.
columnHint.collision: Sold: store · till · receipt of the sale. Held: picking document · its store.
